newsitem.title: USA: Tandy December same-store sales down.
newsitem.headline: Tandy December same-store sales down.

text.p: Tandy Corp said December same-store sales fell five percent compared with a year ago.
Same store sales fell two percent at Tandy's RadioShack division and fell 12 percent at its Computer City division, Tandy said.
The RadioShack results exclude 53 closing McDuff stores and the Computer City results exclude 21 closing Computer City stores, Tandy said.
However, overall sales from Tandy's U.S. and Canadian retail operations rose two percent to $758.9 million in December compared with $747.7 million a year ago.
"RadioShack continues to exceed industry comparable store sales results and once again demonstrates its unique market position," Tandy chief executive John Roach said.

"As we begin 1997, Computer City will shift its focus away from the first-time computer buyer and focus on the existing coputer consumer, along with the (small office/home office) and corporate markets," he said.
Tandy, one of the largest retailers of consumer electronics, sells its products through about 6,800 RadioShack and 92 Computer City outlets, the company said.

Earlier this month, CompUSA Inc said same-store sales in the second quarter ending December 28 rose 1.5 percent, which was about half what Wall Street analysts were expecting. And Circuit City Stores Inc said December same-store sales fell 13 percent.
